definitions.gloss: exports and imports; import and export
definitions.explanation: Exporting and importing taken together; foreign trade in goods. A compact written form of {輸出|ゆしゅつ}と{輸入|ゆにゅう}, common in economic news and business.

examples.japanese: {輸出入|ゆしゅつにゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧。
⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{輸出入|ゆしゅつにゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: My father works for an import-export company.

examples.japanese: ⟦{円安|えんやす}→円安：04854_enyasu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{輸出入|ゆしゅつにゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦バランス→バランス：03870_baransu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: When the yen weakens, it also affects the balance of exports and imports.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {輸出入|ゆしゅつにゅう}⟦{業者|ぎょうしゃ}→業者：13130_gyousha⟧: import-export trader
- {輸出入|ゆしゅつにゅう}⟦{規制|きせい}→規制：02598_kisei⟧: trade restrictions
- {輸出入|ゆしゅつにゅう}⟦{額|がく}→額：02607_gaku⟧: value of exports and imports

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{貿易|ぼうえき}→貿易：01727_boueki⟧: trade — the everyday word for foreign trade as a whole
- ⟦{輸出|ゆしゅつ}→輸出：02094_yushutsu⟧ / ⟦{輸入|ゆにゅう}→輸入：01742_yunyuu⟧: export / import on their own
